environment.description: Lambda function deployed with a Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No CloudFront distribution or API Gateway in front. CORS headers set to allow all origins. An internal admin dashboard at https://ops.internal.company.com has authenticated sessions with cookies. An attacker can craft a malicious page that submits a cross-origin POST to the Lambda function URL, triggering maintenance actions (restart-service, flush-cache) against production targets.
